subject: Candidate partial-day availability — options: condensed on-site, recording, or reschedule
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@example.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, Sophie Tan <sophie@talentbridge.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite interview today — unexpected childcare conflict

Hi Kimberly / Sophie,

I'm really sorry to do this on the morning of my interview, but our nanny had an emergency and I can't stay at the office past 12:30pm today. I can definitely make the morning slots (9:00–12:15), but I'll need to leave immediately after.

I still want to make the interview work — would the team be open to one of these options?
- Condense the most important pieces into the morning (I can do coding + design compacted)
- Do the morning in-person and record the coding exercise so I can finish and send the recording later today
- Reschedule the second half to another day if you prefer a full session

If you can confirm which you'd prefer, I can be on-site at 8:50 and available until 12:30. Again, apologies for the short notice — I tried to find backup care and couldn't.

Thanks for understanding,
Hannah
Candidate — Full Stack Engineer
Hannah Li
attachments: hannah_resume_v3.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@example.com>, Sophie Tan <sophie@talentbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-14T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite interview today — unexpected childcare conflict

Hi Hannah — thanks for the heads up and sorry about the stress this morning. Appreciate you flagging availability so early.

We can accommodate this. Quick proposal so we can lock it in:
1) Condensed plan (preferred): Run a focused morning covering a 40–50 minute coding exercise + a 30-minute systems design conversation. We can skip the afternoon behavioral loop and move that to a follow-up if needed.
2) Recording option: We can give you the coding exercise in-person, you can record your screen/voice while completing it (up to 90 minutes) and upload the recording + repo link before EOD. Interleaved design discussion would stay live.
3) Reschedule: If you'd rather not compress, we can move the remaining half to next week.

I'll coordinate with the interviewers now. If you prefer option 1 or 2, tell me which and we'll send the compact coding brief to your inbox by 09:00.

Kimberly Park
Recruiting Hiring Lead, Redwood Inference
Office: (415) 555-0124
attachments: original-interview-invite.ics
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-14T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: Candidate Hannah Li — morning-only availability (options below)

Team — Hannah (on-site at 8:50) just notified she needs to leave at 12:30 due to a childcare emergency. Options:
A) Condense to morning: coding (40–50m) + design (30m) — drop behavioral loop; we'll follow up asynchronously
B) Run coding now and accept a recorded submission for full coding time (we'll review later)
C) Reschedule entire afternoon loop to next week

I've attached a compact coding stub (compact-coding-stub.md) we can use if we go with A/B. Please reply with availability to take a shortened session or confirm you'd prefer reschedule. If you can do a 45m block, tell me earliest start windows (we're aiming to start coding by 9:10–9:30).

Thanks — Kimberly
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-14T08:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Candidate Hannah Li — morning-only availability (options below)

Kimberly — I can take the system design piece at 10:15–10:45 and then hop out for a calendar hold I have at 11:00. I'm ok with compressing; prefer option A so we get a live design chat.

Marissa
Senior Eng, Frontend
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@example.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sophie Tan <sophie@talentbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-14T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite interview today — unexpected childcare conflict

Thanks all — I appreciate the flexibility. Option A (condensed morning) works best for me. I'll arrive by 8:50.

Couple quick asks:
- Can you confirm the on-site room / remote link for Jonas (if he needs to drop in remotely)?
- If you choose to accept a recorded coding portion, I can do that as a backup, but prefer the live compacted slot.

I look forward to the 9:10 start.

Hannah
